purpose: Canonical index of reusable art masters, content sources, style references, and published website derivatives.

creatures.poseBrief: Kneeling beneath a cottage loom while demonstrating a treadle repair.
Creeping sideways from beneath a cracked mortar in an abandoned apothecary.
Twisting back from an overturned log beside a mountain stream.

Advancing downhill from a rocky pine woodland, medium round shield held correctly forward on the strapped left forearm and shortspear carried low in the right hand for a compact thrust; horned head lowered behind the guard.
Pivoting heavily in mud to line up a charge.
Surging sideways from reeds onto a muddy bank.
Flattening and reforming beneath grain sacks while stalking warmth.
Digging under a tilted farm gate while looking back to listen.
Descending carefully into a ruined courtyard while lighting one brazier.

Standing in a stable three-quarter pose beside her intact anchor tree, one open hand resting flat against its trunk while the other guides two low ribbons of ivy apart across the forest floor; both feet remain distinct and naturally planted, and no limb, staff, or branch merges with the tree.
Kneeling in a mine with one palm to stone, using Earth Sense.
Pulling free from a quarry face, body still half merged with rock.
Stepping down a riverbank while spraying water across its shoulder.
Crouched sideways on a fallen trunk, drawing a bow through leaves.
Crawling headfirst down a rain-dark cathedral buttress.
Pulling an immaterial ferry rope that vanishes into dry sand.
Moving beneath a smokehouse table while twisting into a warning howl.
Climbing a fallen log while shearing a thick root with its mandibles.
Pulling out of a raking dive along a mountain shelf.
Whipping around a ravine boulder, head and tail moving oppositely.
Squeezing from a sea cave with eight countable bracing and reaching arms.
Coiling continuously around a cracked pillar for leverage.
Hanging beneath a ruined roof beam on taut silk lines.
Crouching in a flooded field to lift a stranded wooden cart.
Sliding feet-first beneath a tunnel beam with shield overhead.
Lowering a collapsed roof beam while checking a boundary stone.
Braking asymmetrically just after a raking-dive landing.
Coiling around a bronze burial mask and howling toward a breached roof.
Crawling crabwise through a cave fissure while shielding light-sensitive eyes.
Banking over a coastal cliff with a filthy dropped missile.
Banking through tall meadow grass with talons opening.
Heron-like spirit spearing a patch of fever vapor in an herb garden.
Testing a broken stone bridge with deliberate, intelligent balance.

Striding down broken sanctuary steps in full silver-and-gold plate, round shield raised in a natural forward guard and longspear angled back; calm commanding face framed by a disciplined golden-white dawn halo and radiant aura, with cobalt tabard and vermilion cloak lifted by a sacred wind.
Backing and turning on a rain-dark forest path.
Dropping from a ledge into tall grass in a descending arc.
Lying across a drifting log while hooking a supply bundle with an axe.
Folding a constellation-like body through an overturned astrolabe.
Rolling under a fallen mast using spear and tail as a pivot.
Descending a burial stair seated, one rigid step at a time.
Swinging horizontally around a planted spear through fast current.
Hauling a great axe free from a shattered stump in a rocky ravine.
Vaulting sideways through a ruined window with shield leading.
Skating down steep scree on a slab while catching a falling stone.
Spiraling around a swinging watchtower door as embodied fear.

Standing upright after a light landing on a broad shelf mushroom, head, torso, hips, and feet aligned in one natural three-quarter direction; exactly four translucent wings attach symmetrically behind the shoulder blades with leading edges and tips extending outward, upward, and backward, while one open hand guides a subtle breeze around a luminous seed.
Hopping sideways on a fence rail while snatching a beetle.
Braking and swinging its mass after a missed charge.
Turning slowly around a sea stack, body split above and below water.
Descending a broken staircase backward on hands and feet.
Crawling awkwardly beneath a fallen trunk while a wound closes.
Turning its lower body to mist while levering a locked inn latch.
Flowing through a grounded S-turn between sunlit stones.
Twisting low mid-transformation while pulling at an ankle chain.
Pausing mid-trot in snow to listen toward an off-frame pack.
Climbing an escarpment with two hind legs and wing-wrists.
Crawling belly-down up a loose grain slope without coordination.
